reviews.text: Autumn is the best! I came to see her after a less than great haircut at another salon. She’s gotten me into a better and more modern haircut that I love. Her coloring maintains much longer than I’ve had in the past. Very sweet personality and great memory for small details. Highly recommend!
Evelyn and her staff are very professional and the salon is beautiful and welcoming. I highly recommend Evelyn if you are looking for a fresh new cut or style.
This was my first experience at this salon and with Alaina. She was very knowledgeable, very professional and did an excellent job on my very temperamental hair. I highly recommend her.
